coverage_skeleton: Existing Candidate-B patient/status anchors, rare/empty-image protection plus all lesion-patient images; no cropping; common restored coverage and realized per-status extras for both policies
object_difficulty: 1 if FN at confidence.25/IoU.50, otherwise .5 if FN at IoU.75, otherwise0; existing one-to-one matcher
paired_randomness: Same per-image uniforms and capacity-feasible allocator for both weights; alpha0 exact equality tested; extra-image set is the relevant overlap, not shared coverage
patient_cap_formula: min(3,ceil(.5*N_p)); all bone-lesion-patient extras zero; ceil permits singleton2x, not a strict50% relative cap
reason: Training diagnostics find1208 eligible hard images without rarity priority,1261 hard fracture objects in those images, Spearman.654; bounded equal weighting tests additional information without a parameter search. All potential negatives excluded after technical audit.
weight_formula: R_i=max capped Candidate-B class weights/2; D_i=max mean object difficulty over classes0,3,4,6,7; W_rarity=R_i; W_error=.5*R_i+.5*D_i
